overview: In FRM-like/1, newtonSinh initializes z from pixel. Each loop computes denom = cosh(z), keeps z when its squared size is below 1e-10, and otherwise assigns z - sinh(z)/denom. The pinned julia profile uses 96 iterations.
mathSummary: starts z from pixel; in each iteration defines denom = cosh(z), keeps z unchanged when the squared real-and-imaginary size of denom is below 1e-10, otherwise assigns z - sinh(z)/denom; bailout is |z - zPrev| >= 0.000001.

sourceWalkthrough.explanation: Initialization: init/0 sets z from pixel.
Branch: loop/1 keeps z when denom has squared size below 1e-10; otherwise it assigns z - sinh(z)/denom.

syntaxFeatures.explanation: The cited annotations connect z = pixel, denom = cosh(z), and the change-based bailout.
The cited branch keeps z for a squared denom size below 1e-10; otherwise it applies z - sinh(z)/denom.

steps: Use the pinned julia profile with all controls fixed. Run 48 iterations and then 96 iterations, and record whether the cosh(z) denominator guard or the sinh(z) update changes the observed iteration counts.
parameterExperiment.expectedObservation: The larger cap may expose additional guarded or unguarded sinh/cosh updates; record whether the iteration counts differ.

exercise.prompt: State the two outcomes of the cosh(z) denominator-size guard.
exercise.completionCheck: Your response names all 4 annotations and gives both keeping z and z - sinh(z)/denom.
